description: Which municipality codes and names does MLIT's Real Estate Information Library list for this Japanese prefecture? Give a prefecture code (01-47) or name. Returns the 5-digit municipality codes with Japanese and English names as published by MLIT (XIT002): the join key for realestate_prices_by_municipality and other Japanese public data. Carries the required MLIT credit.

prefecture.description: Prefecture code 01-47 (e.g. 13) or name (Tokyo or 東京都).

name: realestate_municipalities

attribution.description: Required credit (MLIT API terms, Article 7; credit_ja is the required wording) and the statement that counts and statistics are computed by MK Career Planning. Keep it when you pass results on.

provenance.description: Freshness receipts for every upstream source used.

items.description: Freshness receipt for one upstream source.

fetch_status.description: found / empty / stale / unavailable / unsupported (see catalog fetch_status_values).

retrieved_at.description: When this service retrieved the upstream data (null if unknown).

source.description: Publisher and URL of the upstream document or dataset.

upstream_updated_at.description: Update time stated by the upstream, or null when it states none.

stale.description: true = MLIT could not be reached; this is the last list retrieved (see retrieved_at).

status.description: found = MLIT's municipality list for the prefecture; unknown = could not be read (see unknown_reason).

terms.description: URL of the terms of service.

title: Municipality codes in MLIT's list, by prefecture
